title: 第0013章 铁锈雨落人心生疮第0014章 土中生绿芽人心起疯痧
lines: 雨下得邪性。
不是那种润物细无声的春雨，也不是那种痛快淋漓的夏雨。这雨像是从老天爷的伤口里挤出来的脓血，带着一股子浓烈的、令人作呕的铁锈味。
雨滴砸在药王沟干裂的土地上，没有溅起水花，而是像铁水一样“嗞嗞”地冒着白烟。那些枯黄的野草被雨水一浇，非但没有舒展，反而像是被烫到了一样，蜷缩成一团，发出细微的、令人牙酸的“嘶嘶”声。
雪见站在祭台旁边，浑身湿透。雨水顺着她苍白的脸颊往下流，流进嘴里，满嘴都是腥甜的血腥味。
她赢了，她救下了白芷，逼退了独活。
可她的心里却没有一丝一毫的喜悦。
脑海深处，那些草木的哭声不仅没有因为这场雨而平息，反而变得更加凄厉、更加绝望。
“烂了……根都烂了……”
雪见痛苦地闭上眼睛。她终于明白，这场雨根本不是老天爷的恩赐，而是这片土地被压抑了太久的怨气，是那些被独活这样的掌权者逼死的冤魂，化作的一场血泪。
“雪见啊，你闯大祸了。”
一个幽幽的声音在雨幕中响起。
雪见猛地睁开眼。
不知道什么时候，青黛已经走到了她的身后。她依然穿着那件红色的连衣裙，只是此刻，那裙子被雨水浇得紧紧贴在身上，勾勒出她曼妙却透着诡异的身段。她的脸上没有一丝被雨水淋湿的狼狈，反而带着一种看戏般的、高高在上的悲悯。
“你逼独活退了，可你看看这雨。”青黛伸出一根白皙的手指，接住一滴雨水，放在鼻尖嗅了嗅，“这雨里带着毒。你救了白芷的命，却把整个药王沟推向了深渊。”
雪见死死地盯着她：“是你搞的鬼？”
“我？”青黛笑了，笑得像一朵在毒沼里盛开的罂粟，“雪见，你太高看我了。我只是个外来的生意人，我哪有本事让老天爷下铁锈雨？这是你们药王沟的命，是这《草木生死簿》里写好的劫数。”
青黛向前走了一步，凑到雪见的耳边，声音轻柔得像是在情人间的呢喃：“不过，我能救你们。”
雪见浑身一僵。
“独活是个蠢货，他只知道用活人祭神，却不知道这山里的草木，早就被你们这些愚昧的人糟蹋透了。”青黛的目光扫过周围那些在雨中瑟瑟发抖、满脸惊恐的村民，“这雨再下下去，不出三天，地里的草根就会全烂掉。到时候，别说求雨，你们连一口干净的水都喝不上。”
“你到底想说什么？”雪见的声音冷得像冰。
“我想说，时代变了，雪见。”青黛的眼神变得狂热起来，“你们守着那本破书，守着那些虚无缥缈的神明，除了等死，还能有什么出路？把地交给我，把命交给我。我有钱，我有药，我能让这药王沟的人，都活下来！”
雪见看着青黛那张在雨中显得妖冶至极的脸，突然感到一阵彻骨的寒意。
她想起了独活。独活是用封建迷信和宗族权力来压迫村民，而青黛，则是用金钱和欲望来腐蚀村民。
这两个人，一个是吃人的鬼，一个是吸血的妖。
“我不会答应的。”雪见咬着牙，一字一顿地说。
“答不答应，可由不得你。”青黛冷笑一声，转身走进了雨幕中，“雪见，你好好看看，你拼死救下来的这些人，到底值不值得你救。”
青黛走后，雪见转过身，看向那些村民。
她以为他们会感激她，至少，会敬畏她。
可她看到的，却是一双双躲闪的、充满怨毒的眼睛。
“都怪雪见……”人群中，不知道是谁低声嘟囔了一句，“要不是她拦着独活村长，祭了神，老天爷早就下雨了……”
“是啊，现在好了，下的是毒雨，咱们的地全完了……”
“她吃了雪见草，就是个妖孽！她克死了半夏，现在又要克死我们全村！”
那些窃窃私语，像是一把把淬了毒的刀子，狠狠地扎进雪见的心里。
雪见愣住了。
她看着那些她拼死保护的人，看着那些在绝命崖下哭喊着求救的草木，突然觉得一阵荒谬。
这就是她要守护的药王沟吗？
这就是那些草木宁愿粉身碎骨也要保护的人间吗？
content_en:
Rain has evil properties.
It's not the kind of silent spring rain that moistens things, nor the kind of refreshing summer rain. The rain was like pus and blood squeezed out of God's wound, with a strong, nauseating smell of rust.
The raindrops hit the dry and cracked land of Yaowanggou. Instead of splashing water, they emitted white smoke like molten iron. Those withered yellow weeds were watered by the rain. Instead of stretching, they curled up into a ball as if they had been burned, making a tiny, heart-wrenching "hissing" sound.
Xuejian stood next to the altar, soaked to the skin. The rainwater flowed down her pale cheeks and into her mouth, filling her mouth with the sweet smell of blood.
She won, she saved Bai Zhi and forced her to retreat.
But there was no joy in her heart.
"Mother..."
In the back of my mind, the cries of the plants and trees not only did not subside because of the rain, but instead became more miserable and desperate.
"So hot..."
"Poison... so poisonous..."
"It's rotten...the roots are rotten..."
Xuejian closed her eyes in pain. She finally understood that this rain was not a gift from God at all, but the resentment of this land that had been suppressed for too long. It was the blood and tears of the unjust souls who were forced to death by those in power like Du Huo.
"Xuejian, you've gotten into big trouble."
A faint voice sounded in the rain.
Xuejian opened his eyes suddenly.
At some point, Qingdai had already walked behind her. She was still wearing the red dress, but at this moment, the dress was wetted by the rain and clung tightly to her body, outlining her graceful yet weird figure. There was no trace of the rain-soaked embarrassment on her face, but instead a kind of aloof compassion, as if she were watching a play.
"You are forced to retreat, but look at the rain." Qingdai stretched out a white finger to catch a drop of rainwater, put it on the tip of her nose and sniffed, "This rain is poisonous. You saved Bai Zhi's life, but pushed the entire Yaowang Valley into the abyss."
Xuejian stared at her: "Is it you?"
"Me?" Qingdai smiled, like a poppy blooming in a poisonous swamp, "Xuejian, you think too highly of me. I'm just a foreign businessman, how can I make God rain rust? This is your fate in Yaowanggou, and it is the fate written in the Book of Life and Death of Plants and Trees."
Qingdai took a step forward and leaned into Xuejian's ear. Her voice was as soft as a lover's whisper: "But I can save you."
Xuejian froze.
"Duhuo is an idiot. He only knows how to sacrifice living people to gods, but he doesn't know that the vegetation in this mountain has long been ruined by you ignorant people." Qingdai glanced at the surrounding villagers who were shivering in the rain and full of fear. "If this rain continues, within three days, all the grass roots in the ground will rot. By then, let alone praying for rain, you won't even be able to drink a sip of clean water."
"What exactly do you want to say?" Xuejian's voice was as cold as ice.
"I want to say that times have changed, Xuejian." Qingdai's eyes became fanatical, "You are guarding that broken book and those illusory gods. Besides waiting for death, what other way out is there? Give me the land, give me your life. I have money, I have medicine, I can make everyone in Yaowanggou survive!"
Xuejian looked at Qingdai's face that looked extremely coquettish in the rain, and suddenly felt a chill to the bone.
She thought about living alone. Duhuo uses feudal superstition and clan power to oppress the villagers, while Qingdai uses money and desire to corrupt the villagers.
Of these two people, one is a man-eating ghost and the other is a blood-sucking demon.
"I won't agree." Xuejian gritted his teeth and said word by word.
"It's not up to you whether you agree or not." Qingdai sneered, turned and walked into the rain curtain, "Xuejian, take a good look at whether these people you saved with your life are worth saving."
After Qingdai left, Xuejian turned around and looked at the villagers.
She thought they would be grateful to her, or at least, in awe of her.
But what she saw was a pair of evasive eyes full of hatred.
"It's all Xuejian's fault..." Someone in the crowd muttered in a low voice, "If she hadn't stopped the independent village chief and sacrificed to the gods, it would have rained long ago..."
"Yes, it's better now. It rained poisonous rain and our land was completely destroyed..."
"She ate snow primrose, and she is a monster! She killed Pinellia ternata, and now she wants to kill our whole village!"
Those whispers were like knives tempered with poison, piercing Xuejian's heart fiercely.
Xuejian was stunned.
She looked at the people she was fighting to protect and the plants and trees crying for help under the cliff, and suddenly felt ridiculous.
Is this the Yaowanggou she wants to protect?
Is this the world that those plants and trees would rather be broken into pieces to protect?
"mother……"
title_en: Chapter 0013 The rain of rust causes sores on the human heart Chapter 0014 Green sprouts grow in the soil and the human heart goes crazy
